//: Two build roots. `./index.ts` is the package's public barrel; `reorderPluginMigrations` re-exports the migration class from it, so a consumer can register the class without naming a path. The migration is ALSO named here as a root of its own, so that its emission into `lib/src/migrations/` — which the manifest's `files` entry publishes and which a deployment may glob instead — never depends on what the barrel happens to import.
